value.rationale: A uniform, computable complete Aut(T) representation of all two-point tree configuration first homology, rather than known ranks or finite special cases. The branch-local character formula detects exchanges of branching vertices and local direction two-cycles. It gives the invariant-rank by character averaging and character-theoretic decompositions of motion classes, meaningful beyond ordinary Betti data.
